name: focus-engine-integrity
description: Detects large code paste bursts during focus sessions and reports them to the Focus Engine API for viva scrutiny.

focusEngine.apiUrl.description: Base URL of the Focus Engine API server.

focusEngine.pasteThresholdChars.description: Minimum characters in a single insertion to be considered a paste burst.

focusEngine.enabled.description: Enable or disable the integrity watchdog.

focusEngine.authToken.description: JWT Bearer token for authenticating with Focus Engine API.
